**Data pending:** only approved aggregate quality indicators will be rendered.
:::

## Planned checks

- Latest available record date and ingestion timestamp by source
- Daily record-volume changes
- Missing service date and facility percentages
- Invalid or missing identifier counts, reported only as aggregates
- Duplicate-group and unresolved-assignment counts
- Reconciliation between source, canonical-visit, pregnancy, delivery, and baby
  grains

## Publication guard

Before any data frame is rendered publicly, its columns will pass
`assert_public_columns()`. Names, NIKs, phone numbers, addresses, source JSON,
and free text are prohibited from the static output.
